_comment: Everything the agent needs to know about one installation. In
production this lives in the `settings` and `brands` tables, not in a
file: the repository is public and none of it belongs in git.
Copy this to local-config.json, fill it in, and point tools/dry-run.ts
at it to see what the agent would say about your account without
deploying anything. local-config.json is already in .gitignore.

_comment_timeZone: Meta cuts its reporting days in this zone. Asking for 'the last
three days' with a different calendar silently returns a different
range than the one you are reasoning about.

_comment_brands: One entry per business sharing the ad account. Meta has no field for
this: an account holding two brands tells them apart by a prefix in
the campaign name, which is a convention and not a guarantee. A
campaign that matches none of them raises a finding rather than being

_comment_thresholds: Only the numbers that differ from the account's, merged over
them. Useful when one brand's purchase event cannot be trusted:
point resultActions further up the funnel for that brand alone
instead of distorting the whole account.

_comment_retiredPixels: Pixels this account used to use and must not use again. Worth naming
rather than ignoring: an ad cloned from an old one inherits the old
pixel, and its conversions land where no live campaign can bid on
them. An unknown pixel is somebody else's business and is left alone;
a retired one is ours and is a fault.
_comment_customerAreas: Hosts or paths a customer reaches AFTER buying: a members area, a
They matter because the pixel cannot tell them from the shop front.
A retargeting audience built on 'visited the site' quietly collects
everyone logging in to use what they already paid for, and the
campaign chasing new customers spends part of its budget on them.
Note this is not a reason to remove the pixel from those pages. On
many platforms the checkout lives on the same domain as the members
area, so removing it would stop measuring every sale. Naming the
area here keeps the measurement and fixes the audiences.

_comment_asciiOnlyCopy: Off by default: accented copy is correct copy. Worth turning on
only for an account that has already had text reach Meta as
replacement characters, because that damage cannot be undone.

_comment_approvers: Only these addresses can approve by replying. A reply from anyone

_comment: Euros. The daily cap is what stops a bug in a loop; the monthly one
is the number you actually agreed to. When the monthly cap is hit,
the LLM half stops and the deterministic checks keep running.
